answer: Diversity threshold anchors trading rights to varied partners against bulk fakes. An agent must trade with 12 distinct counterparties, at most 20% of volume from any one, like basalt pillars apart. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 12,000 ties at 15 units each, costing 180,000 units, far above one slot's reward. A ferrous log of every pair flags star clusters sharing one hub. An honest agent pays for 12 trades and keeps undiluted rewards.
